integrity.computational_confirmation: Direct adjacency-based exhaustive test through nine vertices on 67 part-size profiles; finite consistency only.
integrity.mathematical_scope: Labelled vertices, unordered nonempty partition blocks, exact two- and three-class enumeration.

scientific_limitations: Only complete multipartite graphs with at least three nonempty parts are covered.
The scalar maximum of three had previously been established; novelty is the complete partition classification and exact multiplicity spectrum.
Historical priority is provisional and independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Exact partition spectrum of total outer-independent coalitions in complete multipartite graphs
